title: Men's Glasses 2-Pack – Lightweight Fashion Frames
descriptionHtml:
Two pairs – for the price you'd expect for one

One pair of glasses is rarely enough. One pair goes missing, one breaks and suddenly you're left without.

Lightweight frames you forget you're wearing

These glasses are made of lightweight, durable PC material with a sleek design. You get two pairs so you always have a spare at hand.

Features

  • Two pairs in one purchase
  • Lightweight, durable PC material
  • Sleek design that suits most people
  • Comfortable to wear all day
  • Good for everyday and leisure

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
